roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring the highest standards of care and compliance within our facility. You will play a key role in fostering a knowledgeable and safe environment for both residents and staff.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, ensuring all nursing personnel are up-to-date with best practices and regulatory requirements. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, including surveillance, policy development, and staff training to prevent and manage infections effectively. This is an urgent opening, with an hourly rate of $40-$42.

This is an excellent opportunity for an RN passionate about education and patient safety to make a significant impact. Join a team committed to excellence and continuous improvement in resident care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care or skilled nursing facility
Demonstrated experience in staff education or development
Knowledge and experience in infection prevention and control practices
Familiarity with state and federal regulations for skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42, compensation based on experience.
